reason: An agent preset for DeepSeek Harness that bootstraps sessions with bash and editor tools, then promotes them to the Standard catalog with configurable context filtering and a one-shot background-job guidance notice.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 配置会话启动阶段的工具锚定、上下文过滤及后续标准工具目录晋级。
summaries.en: Configures DeepSeek Harness sessions with an initial tool bootstrap, optional context filtering, and promotion to the Standard tool catalog.
